NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: This address does not match a page in ContractWatch.

Error.title: This page could not load
Error.body: ContractWatch could not reach its database or file store. Try again in a moment.

Contracts.title: Contracts
Contracts.empty: No contracts yet. Create one to upload its conditions.

errors.name: Enter a contract name of up to 200 characters.
errors.invalid: Choose a form of contract and a language.

upload.title: Upload a document
upload.hint: PDF, DOCX or text, up to 50 MB.
upload.forceOcrHint: Scanned PDFs are detected and read automatically, which can take several seconds a page. Tick this for a scan whose existing text is garbled.
upload.ocrSaving: Splitting the OCR text into clauses…
upload.done: {filename} uploaded. {clauses, plural, one {# clause} other {# clauses}} found.

errors.fileType: Upload a PDF, DOCX or text file.
errors.fileSize: This file is over the 50 MB limit.
errors.uploadFailed: The file could not be stored. Try again.
errors.invalidRequest: The upload request was not valid. Reload the page and try again.
errors.blobNotFound: The uploaded file could not be found. Upload it again.
errors.extractionFailed: The text could not be read. Check that the file opens normally and has no password.
errors.ocrFailed: OCR could not read this file. It stays marked as needing OCR. Upload it again to retry.
errors.documentNotFound: This document no longer needs OCR, or no longer exists. Reload the page.

warnings.pagesWithoutText: These pages have no text layer and were skipped: {pages}. They may be scanned. To read them, upload the file again with OCR ticked.
warnings.docxAutoNumbering: {paragraphs, plural, one {# paragraph uses} other {# paragraphs use}} Word’s automatic numbering, so those numbers are not in the text. Export the file to PDF and upload that instead.

list.title: Documents
list.empty: No documents yet. Upload the general conditions first.
list.summary: {pages, plural, =0 {} one {# page, } other {# pages, }}{clauses, plural, one {# clause} other {# clauses}}

Documents.needsOcr: OCR did not finish for this file. Upload it again to retry.
Documents.failed: The text could not be read from this file. Upload it again, or check that it opens normally.

fallback.tooFewClauses: {clauses, plural, =0 {No clauses were} one {Only # clause was} other {Only # clauses were}} found, so this split may be incomplete.
fallback.clauseTooLong: {clauseRef} has {words} words, so it may contain clauses the splitter missed.

Documents.readByOcr: This text was read by OCR. Check dates, amounts and clause numbers against the scan.

Review.allDone: Every extracted obligation has been reviewed.
Review.nothingYet: No obligations are waiting for review. Run extraction on a document first.

source.title: Source clause
source.noClause: This item names a clause that is not in the document, so there is no source text to show. Check it against the document.
source.quoteNotFound: The quote is not word for word in this clause, so nothing is highlighted. Read the clause before confirming.

notes.lowConfidence: Low confidence: the model gave {confidence, number, percent}. Check that this clause is time-bound at all.
notes.quote-not-in-clause: The model's quote is not word for word in this clause.
notes.quote-shortened: The model's quote was too long, so it was cut to the limit.
notes.unknown-clause-ref: The model named a clause that was not in its batch.
notes.period-without-basis: The model gave a period with no unit.

actions.keys: Keys: C confirm, E edit, R reject

errors.invalid: Check the fields: a title of up to 90 characters, a quote of up to 400, and a unit for any period.
errors.notFound: This obligation no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.unknownClause: No clause in this document has that reference.

outside.title: Review with an outside tool
outside.help: Download the waiting obligations as one file, give it to the reviewer, such as ChatGPT, and upload the file it returns. Decisions are recorded under the reviewer's name. The file holds clause text, so use it only for public or anonymised documents.
outside.invalid: This file is not in the expected format, so nothing was changed.

Register.title: Obligations register
Register.empty: No confirmed obligations yet. Review the extracted obligations first.

FormErrors.invalid: Check the entries and try again.
FormErrors.wrongSender: Only the party the obligation binds can satisfy it. Choose another relation or check the sender.

after.CALENDAR_DAYS: {value, plural, one {# calendar day} other {# calendar days}} after the event, not counting the day of the event.
after.WORKING_DAYS: {value, plural, one {# working day} other {# working days}} after the event, skipping weekends and the contract's holidays.
after.MONTHS: {value, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} after the event, from day to same day.

before.CALENDAR_DAYS: {value, plural, one {# calendar day} other {# calendar days}} before the event.
before.WORKING_DAYS: {value, plural, one {# working day} other {# working days}} before the event, skipping weekends and the contract's holidays.
before.MONTHS: {value, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} before the event, from day to same day.

DeadlineRule.rolled: Moved to the next working day, because the period ended on a non-working day.

Events.noDeadlines: This event generates no due dates.
